# The spine as grammar text

*Generated by `tools/modular_spine_text.py` — the text is authored in the script, the prefab symbols are checked against the registry and the spawn lists. Palle, 23 Oct 2026: "point + mesh(color) + collider = sphere_collider …"; 24 Oct: "can we do this for all the spine but with a symbol in the text for prefabs."*

A name in **[square brackets] is a prefab** — an artifact that exists in the registry and stands on the floors. A bare name is a term of the grammar, saved or proposed. `[?name]` is a prefab the text names that the registry does not have — a hole, printed so it cannot pass as fact.

Notation: `a + b` compose · `a * n` times, array · `association(a)` a surface or a story laid on · `transform(a)` moved, turned, scaled · `replicate(a)` array, recurse, rewrite · `by(a, fn)` a function of index and time · `step(a, rule)` a rule from the neighbours · `connect(a, b)` a relation between named parts · `field(f)` a solid from a function of space · `measure(a, what)` a value read off a thing, retained, compared · `=` names what it makes.

## 1. primitives — Foundation - points, lines, planes, and basic vectors

point + mesh(color) + collider = sphere_collider. Then grab_sphere = sphere_collider + grabbable ([grab_sphere_point] is one). dist(point, point) = length. length = line. line + association(surface) = tape, line + association(mesh_skin_collider) = plank ([timber_plank_1m]), plank * x = plank sizes ([timber_plank_2m]), line + association(mesh_skin_collider) + grabbable = stick ([grab_stick]). association(tape) = walk this line, red line, do not cross. association(tape * 2) = parallel_lines ([parallel_lines]), line_plus, cross_lines ([cross_lines]). association(line_plus) = heath mesh, association(cross_lines) = danger_x. physics_engine(sphere_collider) = trace ([trace_point_ball]), hand_movement(sphere_path) = trace ([hand_telemetry_diptych] reads it). line * 3 = connected edges = triangle ([triangle_specimen]). face(3 * edges) = triangle_base_face — everything in this 3d world is triangles, from here we can make all slides etc. triangle * 2 = quad = plane ([quad]), association(quad) = wooden_plane, association(quad) = walls ([plane_as_wall]). triangle_base_face * 3 = tetrahedron ([tetrahedron], [corner_tetrahedron], [align_tetrahedron]), association(tetrahedron) = plastic_cone ([traffic_cone]). triangle_base_face * 5 = pyramid ([pyramid], [traffic_pyramid_5]), triangle_base_face * 6 = wedge ([wedge_blocker], [align_wedge]), association(wedge) = walk_ramp. quad * 6 = cube ([cube_specimen], [cube_scene], [cube_lines] draws its edges). association(cube) = wooden_box, concrete_block ([concrete_barrier]), cardboard_box ([cardboard_box], [crate]), warhol_box. assemblage(sphere_collider, plank) = elevated_plank, physics_engine(assemblage(box, plain sphere_collider)) = physics_test, assemblage(other things) = stuff, walkways, staging. math(): sphere vs triangle shapes = Melencolia ([diamonds], [diamondtoruscollection], [capsule] — the circle the engine approximates, [budget_of_smoothness] reads how many faces it spent). measure(line, length) = length read beside the line ([axis_line], [coordinate_readout], [CoordinateSystem3M] — where is the point). replicate(profile, column) = a family of columns from one profile; association(borrowed outline) = architecture ([void_primitive_profiles]).

## 21. graphtheory — Connections define structure. The substrate that was always under it all — every cell, force, agent, neuron was a node; every adjacency, attraction, message, weight was an edge.

point + label = node; connect(node, node) = edge; array(node) + connects = graph — the same connections can host different journeys ([two_travelers], [graph_worlds], [void_gt_bridge]).
